content.text:
The evidence conflicts: Tenant 3 reports ammonia highest at 11.6 (borax 9.2), while Tenant 4 reports a repeat test where borax gave 12.1 as the highest reading.

Applying the rule (greatest meter reading has the highest pH): the readings are ammonia 11.6, borax 9.2 (Tenant 3), and borax 12.1 (Tenant 4). The 12.1 borax reading is the greatest of all the readings given. Tenant 4 does not provide readings for the other samples, but it says borax was the highest in that test. The repeat test is also the later measurement, and the irrelevant details (bench wiped, gloves, after lunch) do not change this.

Different tenants may have used different meters, so the readings may not be comparable. Even so, going by the rule and the evidence as given, the greatest reading is 12.1, for borax.

**D**
